empty.title: Nothing to do yet
empty.hint: Create a todo here, or with “+ Todo” from a Slack thread, an issue, a PR or a session. Devdy ranks them by deadline, estimate and priority.

capacity.connect: Connect Google Calendar (Settings → Google) to see today's free time.

calibration.slower: You usually take {factor}× longer than estimated
calibration.faster: You usually finish in {factor}× of the estimated time

confirmDelete.title: Delete todo?
confirmDelete.message: “{text}” will be deleted. This can't be undone.

actual.title: How long did it take?
actual.hint: Estimated {estimate}. Logging the real time helps calibrate future estimates.

week.estimateHint: Total estimate of the todos due this day

settings.title: Focus
settings.hint: Working hours drive the Focus board: deadlines without a time are due at the end of the working day, and time left is counted in working minutes only.
settings.invalidHours: The end of the working day must be after its start.
settings.noDays: Pick at least one working day.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.hint: macOS notifications while Devdy is running; several at once are grouped into one. Clicking one opens Focus on that todo.
reminders.invalidMorning: The morning summary time must be HH:MM.
reminders.workHoursOnly: Outside working hours and on days off, only reminders you set yourself are sent.

kindHints.morning: Today's count, overdue count and what to start with
kindHints.start_by: When a todo must start to make its deadline
kindHints.due_soon: Only for deadlines with a time
kindHints.overdue: Once, right after the deadline passes
kindHints.remind: At the reminder time set on a todo
kindHints.snooze_end: When a snoozed todo is back in "Do now"

calendar.title: Google Calendar
calendar.hint: Busy events of today (not all-day, not "free", not declined) are subtracted from the working hours left to show whether today is overloaded.
calendar.noAccount: No Google account connected — add one in Settings → Google.

calibration.title: Calibrate estimates
calibration.hint: Scale estimates by how long your finished todos really took (median of the last 20, needs 5).

ai.noPlan: No AI plan yet — Analyze breaks the todo into steps, risks and an estimate.
ai.analyzed: Analysis ready — open the todo to see it
ai.suggestHint: Let AI read the source and fill title, deadline, priority and estimate
ai.pickProjectHint: The session runs in a project's folder. The todo will be filed under the project you pick.

errors.busy: An AI request for this is already running.
errors.project_required: Pick a project for this todo first.
errors.no_free_time: No working time is left today.
errors.nothing_to_plan: There is no open todo to plan.
errors.no_google_account: Connect a Google account (Settings → Google) to add blocks to Calendar.
errors.no_plan: There is no plan for this day.
errors.calendar_failed: Some blocks could not be added to Google Calendar.
errors.ai_invalid_answer: The AI answer could not be used. Try again.
errors.calendar_unavailable: Couldn't read today's Google Calendar, so the plan could miss your meetings. Try again in a moment (or refresh the calendar).

plan.hint: Let AI fit today's todos into your free working time
plan.title: Today's plan
plan.pushOne: Add this block to Google Calendar
plan.dropped: {n} block was dropped (outside free time or unknown todo) | {n} blocks were dropped (outside free time or unknown todo)
